cohort: 99 patients undergoing scheduled elective cesarean deliveries at a large academic center
finding: Patients with access to cell salvage had higher postoperative hematocrit, less postpartum anemia, and no difference in complications related to transfusion, despite losing more blood on average.
mod_finding: This study investigated the use of cell salvage in patients undergoing routine cesarean delivery and found that it was associated with higher postoperative hematocrit and less postpartum anemia.
